facts.fact: Journalist Herton-Sena Omoungou writes in a Convergence Afrique op-ed that no law sets out access to administrative documents in Gabon, and a bill announced in 2023 remains a rough draft not yet submitted to Parliament.

GAB.note: Document states nothing this study asks for this country.
Op-ed describes limited access to public information, with no named policy criticised, no cut and no punishment stated.
